title: 三思而后行：验证器引导的具身智能体动作选择
summary: 提出Verifier-Guided Action Selection (VeGAS)框架，通过显式验证步骤提升基于多模态大语言模型的具身智能体在复杂任务中的鲁棒性。VeGAS在推理时采样候选动作集合并使用生成式验证器选择最可靠动作，无需修改底层策略。通过LLM驱动的数据合成策略自动构建失败案例课程，在Habitat和ALFRED基准上实现高达36%的相对性能提升。
summary_en: Proposes Verifier-Guided Action Selection (VeGAS), a test-time framework that improves robustness of MLLM-based embodied agents by sampling candidate actions and using a generative verifier to select the most reliable one. An LLM-driven data synthesis strategy automatically constructs failure case curricula. Achieves up to 36% relative improvement on Habitat and ALFRED benchmarks.
